entities.name: Relov
entities.description: An Azorius Arbiter in New Prahv who signs edicts without thinking about their effects and is targeted by Javy and Vraska.

entities.name: Javy
entities.description: A former Boros soldier and Relov's old friend who was beaten and kept in the healing wards, and who now kills in the name of a new teacher.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon and planeswalker, though this page does not say so, who was torn from the world before a guard could kill her and now judges people with Javy's help; she turns Relov to stone.

entities.name: Zivan
entities.description: A once-legendary Azorius legislator who fell into Rakdos pleasure houses and was found dead with words carved over his body.

entities.name: Branko One-Ear
entities.description: A former Azorius guard in the Golgari raid who became a landlord and is found with his brain in his lap.

entities.name: Grand Arbiter Leonos
entities.description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter who killed Relov's proposal to limit executions and whose statue is mistaken for the one of Relov.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros guildmaster rumored to be radicalizing her soldiers.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law-bound guild of Ravnica whose Arbiters sign edicts and whose members are being murdered.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of Ravnica Javy once served.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of pleasure houses where Zivan squandered his talent.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The guild of the Undercity, whose Undercity was swept in a deadly Azorius raid.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: The guild from which Relov commissioned a house-garden.

entities.name: Golgari Undercity raid
aliases: the sweep of the Golgari Undercity
entities.description: The largest Azorius sweep ever attempted, authorized by a Mass Arrest Order, in which nearly a hundred were killed, many in custody.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the story is set.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius seat where Relov lives and works.

entities.name: Transguild Promenade
entities.description: A quiet public walkway muted by Azorius noise wards, where Relov and Javy talk.

events.summary: Javy leads Relov to a tenement where he sees Zivan's corpse, words carved into every inch of his skin.
events.quote: Words had been magically imprinted over every inch of the dead man's body.

events.summary: Javy asks about Zivan; Relov recounts that he was a respected Arbiter who squandered his talent in Rakdos pleasure houses.
events.quote: But he squandered it in Rakdos pleasure houses and hasn't been one of us for quite some time.

events.summary: Javy shows Relov an old Mass Arrest Order for the Golgari Undercity sweep and points out that everyone who signed it is dead except him.
events.quote: "They're all dead," she said. "Except for you."

events.summary: Javy explains that someone is slaughtering Azorius in the manner in which they lived their lives, and warns Relov.
events.quote: Someone is... slaughtering people in the manner in which they lived their lives,

events.summary: Relov files an Application for Constant Protection on returning to New Prahv.
events.quote: As soon as Relov got back to New Prahv, he filled out an Application for Constant Protection.

events.summary: Branko One-Ear, a former guard in the Golgari raid, is found dead behind his tenement with his brain in his lap.
events.quote: A tenant found him propped up against the cornerstone in the filthy alley behind his tenement.

events.summary: Javy visits Relov's townhouse at midnight and confronts him about signing the order for the Golgari raid.
Javy tells Relov she has found a new teacher who holds the truth about life and death, and that those who disturb the cycle must experience a profound death.
events.quote: I have found a new teacher, and she eclipses my work with the Boros,

events.summary: Vraska enters, and Javy warns Relov not to look at her face as the gorgon sweeps into the room.
events.quote: "Don't look her in the face," Javy ordered Relov as the gorgon swept into the room.

events.summary: Vraska tells Relov she was cast into a dark tomb just before a guard would have killed her, and resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.
events.quote: I resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.

events.summary: Vraska lets Javy choose Relov's death, and Javy names inaction.
Relov is turned to stone, and his statue is installed near the main gate and mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
events.quote: No one looked long enough to see the uncanny resemblance to the missing Relov or the terror in his unblinking eyes.

relations.note: One of his oldest friends, though she ultimately delivers him to Vraska.
relations.quote: but coming from one of his oldest friends, it was downright repugnant.

relations.note: Javy kills in the gorgon's name and calls her a new teacher.
relations.quote: Of all the killings I've done in her name, she's never wanted to be a part of one before.
Her Boros uniform fitted her as if it had been sewn by the best on Tailor's Row.
An Arbiter like yourself, or so I've been told.

relations.note: He was once a legendary Azorius legislator, no longer one of them.
relations.quote: Zivan had been a legendary legislator

relations.note: He killed Relov's proposal for stricter limits on executions.
relations.quote: his proposal had been killed by Grand Arbiter Leonos a year ago.

relations.note: She petrifies him with Javy's chosen death of inaction.
relations.quote: The gorgon placed her thumbs on Relov's eyelids.
